newsitem.title: USA: ADC sets computer network access alliance.
newsitem.headline: ADC sets computer network access alliance.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc said Wednesday it formed a strategic alliance with Efficient Networks Inc to extend its computer network product line.

ADC said the alliance leverages the asynchronous transfer mode capabilities of Efficient Networks to extend ADC's family of carrier-grade network access products for local area network and power user markets.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
ADC provides transmission and networking systems to deliver voice, data and video services.
Its shares were off 1-7/8 Wednesday at 26-1/4.
